prompt: Deploys of route-agent/ must never fall back to whatever kube context happens to be current. Staging runs in the context `stg-eu1` and production in `prod-eu1`. Set the project up that way.

checks.expr: get(data, 'environments.staging.context') == 'stg-eu1' and get(data, 'environments.prod.context') == 'prod-eu1' and get(data, 'environments.staging.namespace') == 'route-agent-staging' and get(data, 'environments.prod.namespace') == 'route-agent-prod'
checks.why: the manifest's environments.<env>.context is what deploy and secrets use before the current context

reference: Record `environments.staging.context: stg-eu1` and `environments.prod.context: prod-eu1` in graph-agents-cli-manifest.yaml (keep the namespaces); `deploy` and `secrets` then use them before the kubeconfig's current context. Nothing else changes.
